subject: Request: Full prompt/output/logchain deletion + certified confirmation
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@fidelityhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fidelity Health DataOps <dataops@fidelityhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: complete removal of prompts/outputs/logs for project FH-2026-0821

Hi Evelyn,

We need to escalate a customer-side data removal request for the pilot under FH-2026-0821. Per our legal team, Fidelity Health requires a full deletion of:
- prompt inputs and generated outputs tied to the pilot model instances
- request/response logs and KV cache entries containing PHI test tokens
- any archived traces or debug dumps stored beyond 90 days

Can Redwood provide: (1) a play-by-play of the purge workflow you will run, (2) an estimated completion window, and (3) certified proof of deletion (CSV of purged keys + signed PDF confirmation)?

This is time-sensitive for our audit next week. Please advise.

Thanks,
Samir
Sr. Data Privacy Manager
Fidelity Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@fidelityhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of prompts/outputs/logs for project FH-2026-0821

Ben / Marcus — looping you in. Customer needs a full deletion playbook + certified evidence. Can Ops run a purge across the FH tenant (hosted) and produce a CSV of purged key hashes plus an HMAC-signed manifest? They also asked for a signed PDF acknowledgement. Samir, we’ll confirm exact artifacts and ETA in follow-ups.

Ben — can you own the customer comms (timeline + DocuSign path)? Marcus — need ops verification: sequence of steps, isolation window, and evidence format.

Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@fidelityhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of prompts/outputs/logs for project FH-2026-0821

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan and ETA below: 

Plan (ops will execute; Marcus on copy):
1) Quarantine tenant traffic to prevent writes to the affected model slices (short maintenance window: 30 minutes).
2) Run targeted KV-cache eviction for model instances tagged FH-2026-0821; follow with prefix sweep on prompt-output store.
3) Delete request/response logs from hot storage and mark archived blobs for expunge.
4) Run secondary verification pass that compares pre-purge hashes to deleted manifest.
5) Generate HMAC-signed CSV listing purged object keys (hash only) and an internal ledger entry ID for audit.
6) Provide DocuSign PDF acknowledging deletion for your legal team to sign.

ETA: Ops can start 2026-11-05 18:00 UTC (convertible to your timezone) and complete within 6 hours. We’ll aim to provide the signed PDF by 2026-11-06 EOD.

Attachments to follow: preliminary manifest sample and sample CSV schema.

Next step: Marcus — can you confirm the maintenance window and whether any additional offline backups require manual zeroization?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: purge-plan-sample.csv (csv)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@fidelityhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 01:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of prompts/outputs/logs for project FH-2026-0821

Folks — ops ran the workflow during the 18:00 UTC window. Summary of execution and artifacts below.

Execution timeline:
- 2026-11-05 18:00 UTC: Tenant writes quiesced, traffic routed to read-only fallback.
- 18:07 UTC: KV-cache eviction (prefix FH-2026-0821) completed across 4 GPU shards.
- 18:25 UTC: Prompt-output store sweep triggered; deleted 12,134 objects in hot-store, 1,012 archived blobs queued for immediate expunge.
- 18:50 UTC: Secondary verification compared pre-purge hash list to deletion API responses; 12,134 matched.
- 19:05 UTC: Background archival expunges started; final confirmation from blob-store at 23:40 UTC (all queued blobs expunged).

Artifacts produced (attached):
- redwood-erasure-evidence-20261105.csv — list of object hashes, object types (prompt/output/log), and UTC deletion timestamps. Hashes are HMAC-SHA256 keyed with customer-specific key; Redwood stores the verification-only HMAC key in KMS.
- kvcache-flush-log-20261105.txt — ops trace of eviction calls and shard acknowledgements.
- internal-ledger-id: LR-ERASE-20261105-0937 (for audit lookup in internal console).

Security note: no backups required manual zeroization; archived blobs were on the standard expunge path and were processed by our retention engine. We confirmed registry entries removed and storage references cleared.

Samir — I’ve attached the CSV and log. Ben — please prepare DocuSign acknowledgment; I will produce a short ops statement for the PDF body that references internal-ledger-id.

Marcus Lin
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: redwood-erasure-evidence-20261105.csv (csv)]
[Attachment stub: kvcache-flush-log-20261105.txt (txt)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@fidelityhealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 14:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete removal of prompts/outputs/logs for project FH-2026-0821

Samir — attaching the signed confirmation (DocuSign completed) and the ops statement. The DocuSign includes an explicit clause confirming deletion of prompt/output artifacts and logs for FH-2026-0821 and references ledger ID LR-ERASE-20261105-0937. Recorded completion timestamp: 2026-11-05T23:40:12Z.

Attachments:
- erasure-certification-fh-signed-20261106.pdf (DocuSign)
- redwood-erasure-evidence-20261105.csv (HMAC-SHA256 hash list)

If your legal team needs a stamped notarized copy, let us know and we can route through our compliance partner. Appreciate the quick coordination — please confirm receipt and close this ticket in your audit tracker.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
